properties.description: Daily schedule for the Sales ETL. Fires at 02:00 UTC, which is after the AdventureWorks Cycles order-entry system's nightly close and well before the reporting day starts -- the window the manual export-and-load process used to occupy. A schedule trigger rather than a tumbling-window trigger because the pipeline manages its own incremental window through etl.etl_watermark: it always reads from wherever the last successful run stopped, so a missed or failed occurrence is picked up by the next one rather than needing a backfill.
